title: Unit 11 Consolidation: nation and nationalism
goal: Review how the new republics tried to build a nation: ideas, symbols, borders and schools.

items: Talk about the nation with relative clauses with a preposition, the passive with *se*, the subjunctive after value judgments, *aunque* and the passive with *ser*.
Say what a nation is and what an imagined community is.
Say which symbols were created and when.
Say what two wars changed and why borders did not match communities.
Use the words of the unit: nation, flag, anthem, border and author.
